retainedReference.title: Quba Mere Diwane
retainedReference.reason: No unique physical footprint or centerline with exact Wikidata identity has been resolved.

pictures.author: Dor Shabashewitz
pictures.observations: Entire960x720 southern exterior picture inspected. Pale octagonal body, tall ribbed central conical roof, shorter peripheral conical turrets with gold finials, narrow windows, corner pilasters, sunburst/fan reliefs, dark plinth and wooden closed double door with short steps. Open rectangular side portico on the east; light tiled roof/stone surfaces, no photoreal texture copied.

pictures.author: AndyHM
pictures.observations: Entire960x935 opposite-side exterior inspected. Same octagonal body, tall central cone, several smaller cones behind/around it, narrow windowed central drum, low cornice/dentil band, a closed central door and the open portico on the left. Seven peripheral towers are a simplified regular allocation around the body, excluding the porch side; no hidden interior inventory is claimed.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific standing Quba Mere Diwane: octagonal pale stone temple body with dark stepped plinth, three closed wooden door bays, narrow recessed windows, engaged pilasters, simplified original sunburst/triangular relief bands, one tall central windowed drum/ribbed cone and seven smaller peripheral drums/cones with restrained gold spindle finials; mapped east side open square-post portico and short stairs. Nearby Ziarat temple, memorials, garden/cemetery and other buildings remain independent host context.
